description: The deferral edge: prosecution was deferred, the participant satisfied the conditions, and no cause number was ever assigned. This is the branch split the registry calls out - the court-acts-on-its-own branch does not reach deferred prosecutions - and it is also the case that raises the unresolved county MC case-type question. Dates are synthetic test inputs, not asserted facts.

boundaryUnderTest: Deferral branch split: the registry states the automatic branch does not apply where prosecution was deferred, so this participant belongs to the five-year branch.
Five-year earliest filing condition: satisfying the conditions of a deferral programme or the judgment imposed.
No cause number was ever assigned, which is the exact case the unresolved county MC case-type question governs.
Clerk has confirmed the court did not act, which is the condition on stage 2.

expectedRouteBehaviour: Stage 1 renders and routes the participant to the five-year branch. Stage 2 remains blocked, and this fixture is the case in which the MC case-type question bites hardest, because no cause number exists to file under.
